name: RefCOCO+
description: Referring expression comprehension dataset containing natural-language expressions grounded to objects in COCO images. RefCOCO+ avoids location words in its expressions; this record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Yu, L., Lin, Z., Shen, X., Yang, J., Lu, X., Bansal, M., & Berg, T. L. (2016). Modeling Context in Referring Expressions. European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV), 69–85. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-319-46448-0_5

license.identifier: Dataset license not specified (not a standard SPDX identifier)
license.notes: The upstream project does not specify a standard SPDX license for RefCOCO+. Images originate from COCO and remain subject to COCO terms and applicable source-image rights. Review the upstream project terms and COCO terms before use or redistribution.
